description: This file contains utility classes and functions for installation and migration processes in vtiger CRM, including database connection checks, module management, file copying, and configuration generation.

classes.name: Installation_Utils
classes.description: Utility functions for installation and migration, including database checks and module management.

classes.name: Migration_Utils
classes.description: Functions for migration processes such as copying files, verifying migration info, and module management.

classes.name: ConfigFile_Utils
classes.description: Class for generating and managing configuration file contents.

classes.name: Common_Install_Wizard_Utils
classes.description: Utility class providing system checks, module package handling, and recommended PHP directives.

methods.name: getInstallableOptionalModules
methods.description: Returns list of optional modules available for installation.

methods.name: getDbOptions
methods.description: Returns available database options based on PHP functions.

methods.name: checkDbConnection
methods.description: Checks database connection and creation status, supports UTF-8 support check.

methods.name: verifyMigrationInfo
methods.description: Verifies migration source directory and database connectivity, including user validation.

methods.name: copyRequiredFiles
methods.description: Copies necessary files from source to destination during migration.

methods.name: getFilesFromFolder
methods.description: Recursively copies files from source folder to destination.

methods.name: installMandatoryModules
methods.description: Installs core mandatory modules from package files.

methods.name: getMandatoryModuleList
methods.description: Returns list of mandatory modules for the system.

methods.name: installSelectedOptionalModules
methods.description: Installs optional modules based on selection.

methods.name: copyModuleFiles
methods.description: Copies module files from source to destination directories.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Performs the migration process, including database updates and module installations.

methods.name: resetUserPasswords
methods.description: Resets passwords for all users in the vtiger_users table.

methods.name: getEncryptedPassword
methods.description: Generates encrypted password based on username and crypt type.

methods.name: copyLanguageFiles
methods.description: Copies language files for installed languages.

methods.name: copyLanguageFileFromFolder
methods.description: Recursively copies language files for specified languages.
